```{python}
#| label: setup
import datetime as dt

import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from google.cloud import bigquery
from itables import show

client = bigquery.Client()


def q(sql: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return client.query(sql).to_dataframe()


# One look for every chart: thin single-hue bars, hairline grid, text in ink colours.
BLUE, ORANGE, AQUA, GRAY = "#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#c3c2b7"
INK, INK2, MUTED, GRID, AXIS, SURFACE = "#0b0b0b", "#52514e", "#898781", "#e1e0d9", "#c3c2b7", "#fcfcfb"
FONT = 'system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif'


def style(fig: go.Figure, height: int) -> go.Figure:
    fig.update_layout(
        height=height, margin=dict(l=8, r=48, t=8, b=8),
        font=dict(family=FONT, size=13, color=INK2),
        paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        hoverlabel=dict(bgcolor="#ffffff", bordercolor=GRID, font=dict(family=FONT, color=INK)),
        legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02, xanchor="left", x=0, title=None),
        bargap=0.42,
    )
    fig.update_xaxes(gridcolor=GRID, zeroline=True, zerolinecolor=AXIS, tickfont=dict(color=MUTED),
                     title=None, tickformat=",d")
    fig.update_yaxes(showgrid=False, tickfont=dict(color=INK2), title=None, ticksuffix="  ")
    return fig


def hbar(df: pd.DataFrame, label: str, value: str, noun: str) -> go.Figure:
    """Horizontal bars, largest on top, one colour, the value at each tip."""
    d = df.sort_values(value)
    fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
        x=d[value], y=d[label], orientation="h",
        marker=dict(color=BLUE, cornerradius=4),
        text=[f"{int(v):,}" for v in d[value]], textposition="outside",
        textfont=dict(color=INK, size=12),
        hovertemplate="<b>%{y}</b><br>%{x:,} " + noun + "<extra></extra>",
    ))
    fig.update_traces(width=0.56)
    style(fig, height=34 * len(d) + 40)
    # Room on the right for the value at the tip of the longest bar.
    fig.update_xaxes(range=[0, float(d[value].max()) * 1.14])
    fig.update_layout(margin=dict(r=12))
    return fig


WORKPLACE = {"remote": ("Remote", BLUE), "hybrid": ("Hybrid", ORANGE),
             "in_person": ("In person", AQUA), "unknown": ("Not stated", GRAY)}


def workplace_counts(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    wide = df.pivot(index="source", columns="workplace_type", values="postings").fillna(0).astype(int)
    wide = wide.reindex(columns=list(WORKPLACE), fill_value=0)
    return wide.rename(columns={k: v[0] for k, v in WORKPLACE.items()}).reset_index()


def workplace_share(df: pd.DataFrame) -> go.Figure:
    """100% stacked bars: one row per source, a 2px gap between segments, grey for 'not stated'."""
    counts = workplace_counts(df).set_index("source")
    share = (counts.div(counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100).sort_values("Remote")
    fig = go.Figure()
    for name, color in WORKPLACE.values():
        fig.add_bar(
            x=share[name], y=share.index, orientation="h", name=name, width=0.5,
            marker=dict(color=color, line=dict(color=SURFACE, width=2)),
            customdata=counts.loc[share.index, name],
            hovertemplate="<b>%{y}</b> · " + name + "<br>%{x:.0f}% · %{customdata:,} postings<extra></extra>",
        )
    style(fig, height=300)
    fig.update_layout(barmode="stack", margin=dict(r=16, t=36),
                      legend=dict(traceorder="normal", entrywidth=110, entrywidthmode="pixels"))
    fig.update_xaxes(ticksuffix="%", range=[0, 100], tickformat="d")
    return fig


def daily_cost(df: pd.DataFrame) -> go.Figure:
    fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
        x=df["day"], y=df["gb_read"], marker=dict(color=BLUE, cornerradius=4),
        hovertemplate="<b>%{x|%b %d}</b><br>%{y:,.1f} GB read<extra></extra>",
    ))
    style(fig, height=300)
    fig.update_layout(bargap=0.5, margin=dict(r=16))
    fig.update_xaxes(showgrid=False, tickformat="%b %d")
    fig.update_yaxes(showgrid=True, gridcolor=GRID, ticksuffix=" GB  ", tickfont=dict(color=MUTED))
    return fig


def draw(fig: go.Figure) -> None:
    fig.show(config={"displayModeBar": False, "responsive": True})


def table(df: pd.DataFrame, **kw) -> None:
    show(df, showIndex=False, classes="display compact", style="width:100%", autoWidth=False, **kw)


kpi = q("""
    select
      countif(is_open) as open_postings,
      countif(is_open and workplace_type = 'remote') as open_remote,
      count(distinct if(is_open, concat(source, '/', company_slug), null)) as companies,
      count(distinct if(is_open and country_key != 'ZZ', country_key, null)) as countries,
      format_timestamp('%Y-%m-%d', max(last_seen_at)) as as_of
    from dev_marts.fct_job_postings
""").iloc[0]

by_region = q("""
    select business_region as region, count(*) as postings
    from dev_marts.remote_jobs group by 1
""")

by_country = q("""
    select country_name as country, count(*) as postings
    from dev_marts.remote_jobs where country_name != 'Unknown'
    group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 12
""")

by_source = q("""
    select source, workplace_type, count(*) as postings
    from dev_marts.fct_job_postings where is_open group by 1, 2
""")

by_employment = q("""
    select employment_type, count(*) as postings
    from dev_marts.remote_jobs where employment_type is not null group by 1
""")

top_companies = q("""
    select company_name as company, source,
           count(*) as open_remote_postings,
           count(distinct if(country_name != 'Unknown', country_name, null)) as countries
    from dev_marts.remote_jobs group by 1, 2 order by 3 desc limit 200
""")

latest = q("""
    select format_timestamp('%Y-%m-%d', published_at) as published,
           title, company_name as company, country_name as country, business_region as region,
           employment_type as type,
           case when salary_min is not null or salary_max is not null
                then concat(ifnull(format("%'d", cast(salary_min as int64)), '?'), ' - ',
                            ifnull(format("%'d", cast(salary_max as int64)), '?'), ' ',
                            ifnull(salary_currency, ''), ' / ', ifnull(salary_interval, '?')) end as pay,
           job_url
    from dev_marts.remote_jobs
    where published_at is not null
    order by published_at desc limit 1500
""")
latest["title"] = [f'<a href="{u}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{t}</a>' for t, u in zip(latest["title"], latest["job_url"])]
latest = latest.drop(columns="job_url")
latest["type"] = latest["type"].str.replace("_", " ")
latest = latest.fillna("")
latest.columns = ["Published", "Title", "Company", "Country", "Region", "Type", "Pay"]

per_source = q("""
    select source,
           countif(is_open) as open_postings,
           countif(not is_open) as closed_postings,
           countif(is_open and description_text is not null) as with_description,
           format_timestamp('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', max(last_seen_at)) as last_run_utc
    from dev_marts.fct_job_postings group by 1 order by 2 desc
""")
per_source["description_fill"] = (100 * per_source["with_description"] / per_source["open_postings"]).round(1).astype(str) + "%"
per_source = per_source.drop(columns="with_description")
per_source.columns = ["Source", "Open", "Closed", "Last run (UTC)", "With a description"]

cost = q("""
    select date(creation_time) as day,
           round(sum(total_bytes_billed) / pow(1024, 3), 1) as gb_read,
           count(*) as jobs
    from `region-us-central1`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS
    where creation_time >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 21 day)
    group by 1 order by 1
""")
month_gb = float(q("""
    select round(sum(total_bytes_billed) / pow(1024, 3), 1) as gb
    from `region-us-central1`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS
    where date(creation_time) >= date_trunc(current_date(), month)
""").iloc[0]["gb"])
```
